say:1:1130939001:1.text: We depend on terrabirds, of course! They're some of the fastest, most intelligent animals out there; every clan has been raising them lately.
say:1:1130939001:1.source_cn: 当然是靠陆行鸟了！它们跑得快，又聪明，附近的部落都养了一些。

say:2:1130939002:1.text: Ours wouldn't have sent us to Alkali for help if the terrabirds hadn't gone crazy and started attacking everyone.
say:2:1130939002:1.source_cn: 要不是之前它们莫名其妙攻击大家，不听命令，部落也不会派...

say:3:1130939003:1.text: Thankfully, they've gone back to their usual, docile selves!
say:3:1130939003:1.source_cn: 还好现在没事了，陆行鸟又变得听话了！

say:4:1130939004:1.text: This whole ordeal has shown me just how much we rely on them.
say:4:1130939004:1.source_cn: 这么一想，我们还真是离不开它呢。
